description: CSD (Contrastive Style Descriptors) ViT-L/14 style encoder. Frozen benchmark evaluator weights (#3374): the sha256 below is the only accepted checkpoint; the sidecar refuses to load anything else.
license: CC-BY-4.0 (weights, per the Hugging Face model card); MIT (upstream code, github.com/learn2phoenix/CSD)
paper: Somepalli et al., Measuring Style Similarity in Diffusion Models, arXiv:2404.01292
checkpointLayout: training checkpoint dict; state dict under `model_state_dict` with a DataParallel `module.` prefix; 297 tensors, 304,752,640 fp32 parameters; contains the full ViT-L/14 visual tower (no `backbone.proj`), `last_layer_style` (1024x768) and `last_layer_content` (1024x768, unused here)
